description: Author and own one flow's design document (the FLOW.md objective flow) at .unikit/gamedesign/flows/FLOW-<slug>.md — the dynamics layer of the GDD (what the player does over time). Create the skeleton and walk the collaborative section-cycle to write its objectives, pacing, dependencies, and funnel events ("design the first-session flow", "map the onboarding sequence", "write the FLOW for the boss encounter"), AND revise it after approval under the delta discipline ("retune the pacing", "add a branch", "change a GOAL", "rework the onboarding") — a cue/number change is Tuning, a small step change a Tweak, restructuring a Rework; each bumps the version and logs the delta. Selects the wiring mode (linear | conditional | emergent) and re-renders the ## Flow Map [gen] / ## Funnel [gen] blocks in GAME.md. To add or detail a system use /unikit-gd-system; to edit GAME.md content use /unikit-gd-spec; to apply a multi-zone edit use /unikit-gd-apply; for a new game concept use /unikit-gd-brainstorm.
